mapper.sql: select u.user_id,u.discountt,u.isshow, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.odr,u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.password, u.sex,u.rise, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.remark,u.domain, u.user_new_type,u.user_use,u.id_card,u.adress,u.business_license_img,u.hand_idCard_img,u.front_idCard_img,u.reverse_idCard_img,u.real_name, u.camp_number,u.hxusername,u.hxuuid,u.supydiscountminamount,u.qq,u.weixin,u.real_status,u.guarantee_ratio,u.guarantee_royalty, d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.status as dept_status,u.supydiscount, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.status as role_status ,u.host ,u.steam_number from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_user where user_id = #{id}

select distinct u.user_id,u.discountt, u.dept_id,u.isshow, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.phonenumber, u.status, u.create_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.del_flag = '0' and (r.role_id != #{roleId} or r.role_id IS NULL) and u.user_id not in (select u.user_id from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id and ur.role_id = #{roleId})
AND u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND u.phonenumber like concat('%', #{phonenumber}, '%')
${params.dataScope}
where u.user_name = #{userName}
where u.hxusername = #{toUser}
where u.`status`=0 and u.del_flag='0' and u.hxusername is not null and u.hxusername != ''
